exam_facts.note: Written knowledge test: handbook states an 80% minimum passing score (physical p19, printed p11) and describes content as driving rules, regulations, procedures, and highway signs (physical p18, printed p10); Section Twelve is an 11-question sample test with answers (physical p80). The handbook states no total question count and no time limit.
